title: Cloud servers
intro: Servers at your cloud providers. Each one joins Polaris as it boots.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.emptyHint: Connect one to create servers there.
accounts.removeBody: Polaris forgets this account's credentials. Servers at the provider are not touched.
accounts.name: Name

servers.title: Servers
servers.emptyHint: Create one and it appears in Servers once it has booted.
servers.name: Name

create.title: Create a server
create.stepBoot: Booting and installing what Polaris needs
create.done: Ready. It is listed in Servers.
create.priceNote: {price} per month at the published price
create.noPriceNote: This provider does not publish prices through its API, so no cost is shown.

resize.title: Resize {name}
resize.stoppedFirst: Power the server off first: this provider only resizes a stopped server.

destroy.title: Destroy {name}?
destroy.body: The server and its disk are deleted at the provider, and it is removed from Polaris. This cannot be undone.

errors.generic: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
errors.credentials: Those credentials are not in the form this provider uses.
errors.secretLost: This account's credentials can no longer be read. Remove it and connect it again.
errors.serverNotFound: That server is not here any more.
errors.nameTaken: A server with that name already exists in this account.
errors.notReachable: A new server could not reach this Polaris: its address is only valid on your local network. Give Polaris a public domain in Management > Domains, then try again.
errors.enrollmentExpired: The server did not join Polaris in time. Destroy it and create it again.
errors.goneAtProvider: The provider no longer has this server.
errors.noResize: This provider does not resize servers through its API.
errors.unknownSize: That size is not offered in this region.
errors.confirmName: The name typed does not match.
